urls.rationale: Title 3 Subtitle A - Legislature contains Chapter 305 (Registration of Lobbyists), consistent with the TX 2015 placement of the lobbying-disclosure regime under subtitle-a.

notes: Intermediate descent: Title 3 page exposes subtitle-level links only. Subtitle A (Legislature) is the correct branch (per TX 2015 ground truth, Ch. 305 lives under subtitle-a). Subtitle B (Legislation), C (Legislative Agencies), and Z (Misc) are not the lobbying regime.
